_comment: Second Brain OS — settings template. Merge this 'hooks' block into your user-level ~/.claude/settings.json (or a project .claude/settings.json) to wire the attentional + memory engine. These hooks are an OPTIONAL ENHANCEMENT — the core brain runs without them. Replace {{PLUGIN_HOOKS_DIR}} with the absolute path to this plugin's hooks/ directory (e.g. ~/.claude/plugins/second-brain-os/plugin/hooks). On Windows use forward slashes or escaped backslashes. Run /brain-doctor anytime to check which of these are wired. Built on the Second Brain framework by Asadulelah.
_attribution: Built on the Second Brain framework by Asadulelah.

env._comment_env: entity-recall (and the legacy context-router) read the vault root from here. Point it at your vault.

hooks._unlocks: Indexes every past Claude Code conversation into a local search DB (incremental, ~2 s). Rows outlive the transcripts Claude Code deletes.
Loads the persisted session pool so a new session self-collects prior state instead of starting cold.
When a prompt names a person or venture with a vault page (by name or alias), injects that page's current state. Needs no keyword map.
Keeps the live session pool fresh as the conversation moves.
Persists session state at the end of a turn/session for the next one to load.
